title: kGT6NEIAddon
description: add modern NEI features compact for gregtech6
body:
This mod added newest NEI feature support for gregtech6. 
Feature List: 
1. add correct machine icon for every type of recipe map.
2. every usable machine for a recipe type will displayed at left side panel
3. add Material Shape and Crucible Shape to see what shape can a material become.

Because gt6 recipe map designs, most addon of gt6 is also usable.
